d:
Mahindra Thar OG has officially launched in India, bringing a major update to the three-door Thar. But what exactly has changed?
In this PowerDrift QuickEase, Aatish Mishra breaks down everything new on the 2026 Mahindra Thar OG. It gets more powerful petrol and diesel engines, Terrain Modes, six airbags, front parking sensors, all-disc brakes and an updated ESP suite.
